Crown Seal Public Company Limited is a manufacturer and distributor of Crown Caps, 
Pilfer -Proof Caps, Maxi Caps, Plastic Caps and Composite Cap used as bottling and 
container seals for products namely carbonated drinks, milk, beer, liquor, soda, 
drinking water and medical supplies including the hand -held capping machine and 
Maxi -Cap Sealing machine. 
Furthermore, the Company also earns the revenue from the printed sheets service.

Mega Trends
 -
Driven Packaging Trends 
Insight: Modern consumers demand fast, simple, and hassle -free experiences in their 
busy lives.
Packaging Response: Design for ease of use, portability, and reseal ability. 
Enable easy sorting and disposal (e.g. detachable or mono -material components).
Insight: Technology is seamlessly integrated into daily life —from shopping to smart home 
management.
Packaging Response: Use QR codes or RFID tags to share product lifecycle, recycling info, 
or sourcing transparency. Support real -time engagement and transparency for tech -savvy 
users.
Insight: Consumers seek value that balances price, functionality, and sustainability.
Packaging Response : Use recyclable, reusable, or biodegradable materials. Communicate 
long -term cost -effectiveness and added value.
Insight: Eco-packaging or sustainable choices now shape consumer behavior and 
business strategy.
Packaging Response: Shift to sustainable materials like paper -based or mono -material 
plastics. Ensure compliance with regulations (e.g. plastic reduction mandates).
